records.context: The entry records the backbone, channel policy and digest of readable local checkpoint bytes without downloading or loading a model. Public backbones use timm cache metadata; OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT use pinned Hugging Face revisions; SubCell uses its official torch hub checkpoint; a local DINO encoder uses its configured checkpoint path. Cell-DINO uses the declared local checkpoint only when stable regular-file bytes match its expected SHA-256; changed or mismatched files leave no digest. Foundation entries name the original provider and checkpoint URL. A checksum alone does not verify a model or establish its training-data provenance.
records.label: spacr.embeddings.encoder_entry#2
records.source: The entry records the backbone, channel policy and digest of readable local checkpoint bytes without downloading or loading a model. Public backbones use timm cache metadata; OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT use pinned Hugging Face revisions; SubCell uses its official torch hub checkpoint; a local DINO encoder uses its configured checkpoint path. Cell-DINO uses the declared local checkpoint only when stable regular-file bytes match its expected SHA-256; changed or mismatched files leave no digest. Foundation entries name the original provider and checkpoint URL. A checksum alone does not verify a model or establish its training-data provenance.
records.translation: A entrada regista a rede base, a política de canais e o resumo dos bytes legíveis do checkpoint local, sem transferir nem carregar um modelo. As redes base públicas usam os metadados de cache do timm; OpenPhenom e ChAda-ViT usam revisões fixadas do Hugging Face; SubCell usa o seu checkpoint oficial do torch hub; um codificador DINO local usa o caminho de checkpoint configurado. As entradas de modelos fundacionais indicam o fornecedor original e a URL do checkpoint. Uma soma de verificação, por si só, não verifica um modelo nem estabelece a proveniência dos seus dados de treino. Cell-DINO só usa o checkpoint local declarado quando os bytes estáveis de um ficheiro regular correspondem ao SHA-256 esperado; ficheiros alterados ou que não correspondem ficam sem resumo.

records.context: **What it produces.** One row per object and one column per dimension, named ``emb_c<channel>_<dimension>`` under the per-channel policy and ``emb_<dimension>`` under projection, with the model-zoo entry that made them -- backbone, policy and the checksum of the weights on this machine. Two processing sessions' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless all three match, which is why the entry is part of the result rather than a log line. The preview shows the first few dimensions of the first fifty objects. The alpha Save for Similar extracted image regions action stores the complete matrix in the database that supplied the loaded objects, so Annotate can search those vectors. Folder and programmatically supplied extracted image regions have no database object identity and cannot use this action.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#5
records.source: **What it produces.** One row per object and one column per dimension, named ``emb_c<channel>_<dimension>`` under the per-channel policy and ``emb_<dimension>`` under projection, with the model-zoo entry that made them -- backbone, policy and the checksum of the weights on this machine. Two runs' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless all three match, which is why the entry is part of the result rather than a log line. The preview shows the first few dimensions of the first fifty objects. The alpha Save for Similar crops action stores the complete matrix in the database that supplied the loaded objects, so Annotate can search those vectors. Folder and programmatically supplied crops have no database object identity and cannot use this action.
records.translation: **O que produz.** Uma linha por objeto e uma coluna por dimensão, chamadas ``emb_c<channel>_<dimension>`` na política por canal e ``emb_<dimension>`` na projeção, acompanhadas da entrada do catálogo de modelos que as gerou: rede base, política e soma de verificação dos pesos nesta máquina. A dimensão 17 de duas execuções tem o mesmo nome mas significado diferente se os três dados não coincidirem; por isso a entrada faz parte do resultado e não apenas do registo. A pré-visualização mostra as primeiras dimensões dos primeiros cinquenta objetos. A ação alfa Guardar para recortes semelhantes armazena a matriz completa na base de dados que forneceu os objetos carregados, para o Annotate pesquisar esses vetores. Recortes de pastas ou fornecidos por código não têm identidade de objeto na base de dados e não podem usar esta ação.

records.context: Five classic themes remain in the menu alongside six data-art materials, each chosen to read as a different kind of movement:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#2
records.source: Five classic themes remain in the menu alongside six data-art materials, each chosen to read as a different kind of movement:
records.translation: Cinco temas clássicos permanecem no menu ao lado de seis materiais de arte de dados, cada um escolhido para expressar um tipo diferente de movimento:

records.context: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre. The older :class:`BokehEngine` and :class:`ResonanceEngine` remain importable for direct callers, but are no longer menu choices or factory entries.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#5
records.source: ``aurora`` Three overlapping curtains of vertical rays, folding along their own length. The folds are travelling waves — several superposed frequencies running lengthwise along the arc — with brightness surges on a separate schedule, a sharp lower edge, a diffuse top, and the real thing's vertical colour order: green through the body, red high up, a violet fringe underneath. ``ripple`` Concentric rings expanding out of three fixed sources and fading as they grow, like rain on water. Soft-edged, so it never reads as line work. ``drift`` A slow starfield in three parallax layers: small, dim, slow ones behind; bigger, brighter, faster ones in front. The one crisp theme. It travels up, down, or every which way — see :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``cells`` Cells drifting through the field, turning as they go — a soft body, a slightly brighter membrane where the edge is seen nearly edge-on, and a distinctly brighter nucleus set off centre. The older :class:`BokehEngine` and :class:`ResonanceEngine` remain importable for direct callers, but are no longer menu choices or factory entries.
records.translation: ``aurora`` Três cortinas sobrepostas de raios verticais, dobrando-se ao longo do próprio comprimento. As dobras são ondas viajantes — várias frequências sobrepostas correndo no sentido do comprimento ao longo do arco — com surtos de brilho em um cronograma separado, uma borda inferior nítida, um topo difuso e a ordem vertical de cores da coisa real: verde pelo corpo, vermelho no alto, uma franja violeta embaixo. ``ripple`` Anéis concêntricos que se expandem a partir de três fontes fixas e se apagam à medida que crescem, como chuva na água. Bordas suaves, para que nunca pareça desenho de linhas. ``drift`` Um campo de estrelas lento em três camadas de paralaxe: pequenas, fracas e lentas atrás; maiores, mais brilhantes e mais rápidas na frente. O único tema nítido. Ele se move para cima, para baixo ou em todas as direções — veja :data:`DRIFT_DIRECTIONS`. ``cells`` Células flutuando pelo campo, girando enquanto passam — um corpo suave, uma membrana um pouco mais brilhante onde a borda é vista quase de perfil, e um núcleo nitidamente mais brilhante, fora do centro. As classes anteriores :class:`BokehEngine` e :class:`ResonanceEngine` continuam importáveis para chamadas diretas, mas já não são opções do menu nem entradas no registo de criação.

See :data:`SPACEOUT_THEME` and :class:`FractalEngine`.
